code:
git status                      # start clean
docker run ... course-agent     # the run above
opencode run "<the job>" --auto 2>&1 | tee agent-run.log   # inside the container
# ...agent works, you go and do something else...
less agent-run.log              # the action log that run wrote
description: Four commands that start from a clean tree, run the job inside the container, and read the action log afterward.

steps.description: This is the workflow end to end, in four commands. The page says a clean tree before the run makes `git status` afterwards a complete list of what the agent did, and `git checkout -- .` an instant undo.
`git status` starts clean, so the run begins from a known state and every later change is attributable to the agent.
`docker run ... course-agent` is the run from the previous section, with the one bind mount and no credentials.
`opencode run "<the job>" --auto 2>&1 | tee agent-run.log` runs the job inside the container without prompts and writes the combined output to a log file.
The comment marks the wait while the agent works, and `less agent-run.log` reads the action log that the run wrote.
